Do A and B name the same business concept (the same real-world thing, so the classes model one concept under different names)? Concepts that merely share attributes such as an id or a date are not the same.

### A
concept: Treatment Product
where: TreatmentProductRepository (uses), src/persistence/repositories.ts, component persistence

response.rationale: These are two different concepts. A is a Treatment Product: the catalogue item kept as TreatmentProductRecord in TreatmentProductRepository ("private readonly items = new Map<string, TreatmentProductRecord>();"). TreatmentService manages it through addProduct and listProducts. B is a Treatment: something applied to a hive that has a start date ("Date.parse(t.startDate)"), which TreatmentService.recordTreatment records. A treatment uses a product, but the product (the substance or item) and the treatment (the event of applying it) are separate things. The fact that TreatmentService has distinct addProduct and recordTreatment methods backs this up.
